QuestInfo.name: [Mechanical Hearts] Soak Up the Sun
QuestInfo.0: It looks like someone from Aspire Industries needs your help.
QuestInfo.1:
Take the Solar Battery out and charge it for the Aspire Industries employee.\r\n
#r(You can do this 3 times a day.)#k
QuestInfo.2: As requested, you charged the Solar Battery for the Aspire Industries employee.

0.0: Hello #h0#. Welcome to #bAspire Industries#k, manufacturers of joy and peace-of-mind.
0.1: As I'm sure you've heard, we're releasing a line of premium androids called #cWondroids#. I'd like to make you a special offer in exchange for, um, helping spread the word about our products.
0.2: Hold onto this nifty, proprietary Aspire #b#esolar battery#n#k as you go about your business. #b#e30 minutes#n#k should be enough for a full charge, and turn some heads.\r\nThen bring it straight back here.\r\nIn return, I will give you an #bAspire Visitor's ID#k ypu can use to take a tour of our company, and an #bAspire Commemorative Coin#k that can be used to purchase various souvenirs. Sound good?

yes.0: Good. I'll see you in 30 minutes.\r\n#fs10#Phew... We're gonna need as much as we can get our hands on...\r\nW-what? I didn't say anything. You must be hearing things. Thanks for visiting #bAspire#k!

no.0: Y-you don't want to take the tour? I guess it can't be helped.\r\nHave a good day.

item.0: The #bsolar battery#k isn't done charging yet.\r\nIt needs a full #b30 minutes#k from when I first handed it over to you.\r\nThank you for visiting Aspire, manufacturers of joy and peace-of-mind.
